keyEvents.text: Amar Dedic (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Newcastle United 0, Arsenal 1. Eberechi Eze (Arsenal) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Kai Havertz with a through ball.
First Half ends, Newcastle United 0, Arsenal 1.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Ramsey replaces Sean Steur.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Tino Livramento replaces Amar Dedic.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Anthony Elanga replaces Jacob Murphy.
Second Half begins Newcastle United 0, Arsenal 1.
Delay in match because of an injury David Raya (Arsenal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Newcastle United 1, Arsenal 1. Harvey Barnes (Newcastle United) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by William Osula.
Declan Rice (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Harvey Barnes (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Newcastle United 2, Arsenal 1. Malick Thiaw (Newcastle United) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Joe Willock following a corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Delay in match because of an injury David Raya (Arsenal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Arsenal. Myles Lewis-Skelly replaces Bruno Guimarães.
Substitution, Arsenal. Kepa Arrizabalaga replaces David Raya because of an injury.
Substitution, Arsenal. Christos Tzolis replaces Eberechi Eze.
Goal! Newcastle United 2, Arsenal 2. Noni Madueke (Arsenal) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Martin Ødegaard.
Dan Burn (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Noni Madueke (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Yoane Wissa replaces Joe Willock.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Sven Botman replaces Lewis Hall because of an injury.
Substitution, Arsenal. Viktor Gyökeres replaces Kai Havertz.
Substitution, Arsenal. Mikel Merino replaces Martin Ødegaard.
Viktor Gyökeres (Arsenal) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Newcastle United 2, Arsenal 2.
